title: Annual Information Return of Income Payments Subjected to Final Withholding Taxes
worst_finding: Page 1 Item 7 Registered Address truncates our 126-character address at '...1258 PASEO DE' (dropping the last 55 characters: 'ROXAS COR AYALA AVE BRGY SAN LORENZO MAKATI CITY'); also, overflowing Item 11A ('PH-US TAX TREATY ART 11') wipes out the '11A If yes, specify' label to its left.

test_return.schedules: All 12 quarterly rows across Schedules 1 (1601-FQ), 2 (1602Q), and 3 (1603Q) filled with large amounts; Page 2 Part III Schedules 4, 5, and 6 are format-only on the official BIR form. Item 3 (19) and Item 11A ('PH-US TAX TREATY ART 11') entered by hand on the form page, saved, and reloaded from Filings.

findings.detail: The 126-character address is split across line 1 (40 slots) and line 2 (31 slots + 7A ZIP) and hard-truncated at 'UNIT 1408 TOWER B RESIDENCIAS DE SAN LOR / ENZO CONDOMINIUM 1258 PASEO DE', dropping the remaining 55 characters ('ROXAS COR AYALA AVE BRGY SAN LORENZO MAKATI CITY').

When a value longer than 16 characters ('PH-US TAX TREATY ART 11') overflows the 11A comb, the overflow white band covers the '11A If yes, specify' static caption to its left so the item label disappears completely.

findings.area: Page 1 — Part II Schedules 1, 2, and 3 Penalties column (all 12 quarterly rows)
findings.detail: All 12 row amounts in the Penalties column (117,500.50..175,002.00) print left-aligned flush against the left cell border, whereas their TOTAL rows (545,005.00, 585,005.00, 625,005.00) and the Taxes Withheld and Total Amount Remitted columns print right-aligned.
Official 'Guidelines and Instructions for BIR Form No. 1604-F' block is omitted from the frozen sheet, leaving the bottom half of Page 2 blank.

verified_ok: Page 1 Item 1 Year (2025 comb), Item 3 Sheets (19), Item 4 TIN, Item 5 RDO (039), Item 6 Name (full 40-char name), Item 7A ZIP (1100), Items 8/8A/11 checkboxes, Item 9 Contact Number, Item 10 Email Address, and Page 2 header TIN and Withholding Agent's Name all print cleanly.
Part II Schedules 1, 2, and 3 Taxes Withheld and Total Amount Remitted columns and all TOTAL rows compute and print cleanly right-aligned.
